label: Prime Power Pieces
subgoals: Every finite abelian group decomposes into cyclic groups of prime power order.
The decomposition is unique up to reordering of the factors.

label: Counting the Types
subgoals: The number of abelian groups of order p to the n equals the number of partitions of n.
For a general order, multiply the counts attached to the prime exponents.

label: Invariant Factors
subgoals: The invariant factor form orders the cyclic factors so that each order divides the next.
The elementary divisor form keeps the prime powers separate.
